_about: Shared do-not-call key fixture. call_suppressions/{id} is keyed by lower-case hex sha256 of the trimmed E.164 number. The web app (sahayakai-main/src/lib/call-suppression.ts, phoneSuppressionId) and the sahayakai-agents bridge (telephony/suppression.py) pin this same pair in their own tests; if any of the three ever disagree, an opt-out is written under one key and looked up under another, and the parent is called again. Made-up numbers from the +9198000001xx test range.
